description: Check whether an email address is valid and deliverable before you send. Returns status, score, MX and mailbox checks, catch-all and disposable flags. Use it when: You are about to send an email or store a contact and want to avoid bounces. Not for: Finding someone's email address; it only checks one you already have. Returns: Status (valid, invalid or risky), a score, domain, MX and mailbox checks, catch-all, disposable and role-based flags, and a typo suggestion. Typical time: about 4 s. Price: $0.003 per email, charged only on success. One call = one email check.
name: email-verify
title: Email address verifier
